description: Native claim -> construct -> close lifecycle between the XaaS fabric dispatcher and the zcode CLI. Shared fixture: this file is byte-identical in xaas (priv/zcode_plugin/gall-work.contract.json) and zcode-cli (test/fixtures/gall-work.contract.json); both sides' tests pin its sha256. Any change must land in both repos in the same wave.

argv_optional.--provider <id>: request a specific execution provider (registry still gates enabled-ness)

env.XAAS_MCP_URL: optional: overrides the fabric MCP endpoint
env.XAAS_MCP_TOKEN: optional: overrides the bearer token secret
env.ZCODE_CONSTRUCT_DEADLINE_SECONDS: optional: default construct-turn deadline when the flag is absent

capability_discovery.degrade: a server lacking either leg degrades typed: stages.discovery = {ok:false, code:'tools_list_unsupported'|'initialize_unsupported'} and the static tool vocabulary below stands; discovery failure never fails a dispatch

arguments.provider: zcode (resolved from the execution-provider registry; never hard-coded)

heartbeat.failure: heartbeat failures are surfaced in close evidence (heartbeat_failures), never dropped

cancel_work.used_by: SIGINT/SIGTERM cancellation, the internal construct deadline, and crash-window reclamation; fallback when unsupported: refuse(reason blocked)

execution_provider_registry.law: enabled:false on a provider means it cannot be selected; selection is fail-closed (registry_invalid refuses; a disabled default falls through to the next enabled rule, else provider_disabled); with no registry file the built-in zcode provider stands; work-order identity, authority, acceptance and receipt schema carry NO provider identity -- the provider appears only as a capabilityId left-segment plus this descriptor

work_order_file.origin_authority: work-order origin authority, carried from the lease descriptor or claim payload into the file and close evidence; never fabricated

goal_transport: work-order file: the goal NEVER travels on argv; gall-work writes <tmpdir>/xaas-fabric/<sha256(realpath(cwd))>.work-order.json and the construct prompt references only that path
crash_reconciliation: at startup, stale lease files for the cwd are reconciled with the fabric: expired or fabric-terminal -> cleared; live past the 2x-heartbeat grace -> reclaimed via cancel_work (fallback refuse) with execution.crash + receipt persisted; genuinely live elsewhere -> left untouched; failures never fail the dispatch (the persist conflict guard remains the backstop)

stages.failure: never fails the dispatch; outcome recorded in stages.reconcile
typed degrade (tools_list_unsupported / initialize_unsupported); static vocabulary stands
exit 65 on live lease_conflict for this cwd
turn failure still closes: outcome blocked with evidence.runtime_exit_code; receipt sealed; exit 0; cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM) or internal deadline closes via cancel_work, fallback refuse
typed refusal, exit 1, close error surfaced
after a sealed terminal receipt the gate lease file is cleared; a clear failure is recorded, never fatal

outcome_mapping.construct_cancelled_or_deadline: cancel_work (fallback refuse blocked); receipt sealed; exit 0; code construct_deadline_exceeded or cancelled_<signal>

exit_codes.0: a fabric receipt was sealed (close_candidate, refuse, or cancel_work succeeded); the epoch is terminal
exit_codes.1: typed failure with no receipt (claim refused, fabric unreachable, close refused, provider selection refused)
exit_codes.65: lease_conflict: a different live lease is already saved for this cwd
exit_codes.142: killed by the external dispatcher deadline; the lease expires by TTL

replay_binding: close evidence carries replay_binding {worker, contract_version, contract_sha256, provider, worker_id, epoch_id, idempotency_key, work_order_iri?, base_sha?, origin_authority?}; OCEL receipts bind replay_binding via XAAS_REPLAY_BINDING
no_fallback_law: neither side may fall back to the /xaas claim_next prompt protocol for this dispatch; an old CLI without native gall-work exits non-zero and the dispatch is classified failed, never re-dispatched as a prompt
